title: DigitalTrainer
tagline: The project provide Fitness Exercises in 3D animations for users to build custom training. If users do their training in front of a web camera, they record their motion on MUD for further improvement, analysis and sharing.
description: This project combine the power of blockchain, web 3d and deep learning models. Our purpose is to bring a healthy lifestyle to more people. Especially to those who don't have access to a gym. Users can do customized exercise comfortably at home any time at their convienience. The motion capture deep learning model can help users to improve and understand their own exercise, the blocktrain help to preserve and share their training history.
how_its_made: This project uses Threejs for web 3d rendering, the mannequins are from readyplayer.me. The motion capture model is Google's Mediapipe which is state-of-art and realtime. The storage is MUD. With geometry transformation we project user's pose to a silhouette on the website, and compare user's motion with standard exercise which we collected from mixamo.com.
